tei:div.tei:p: 231) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: bde chen mtsho rgyal ma'i gsang dbang skal ldan rjes 'dzin 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang bzhugs: 232) na mo pad+ma kār ye: sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'dud: ma 'ongs skal ldan las can bu: mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la 'jug nas: don gnyis 'dzin pa'i rigs ldan la: gsang dbang ye shes sgo 'byed bstan: las 'phro ldan pa'i dpal du shog: dben zhing yid 'ong 'tshe bral pa: byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas gang rung: skal ldan rjes 'dzin smin pa'i thabs: dkyil 'khor la sogs sta gon bsags: bum thod man shel 'od lnga dang: sku tsaka rig ma gtor ma sogs: ci dgos sta gon legs par bsgrigs: bdag mdun dkyil 'khor sgrub la brtson: slob dpon lta spyod ldan pa yis: chas gsol las can gral du 'khod: khrus bya bgegs bskrad srung 'khor bsgom: yid ches lo rgyus spro ba bskyed: maṇ+ḍal phul zhing gsol gdab ni: kyai: bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa che: bdag cag skal ldan bu mchog la: smin byed dbang bskur bka' drin stsol: dam tshig ji bzhin bdag gis bzung: lan gsum dang: slob dpon gyis: e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu: khyed cag las dang skal ba bzang: yang gsang mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la: 'jug spro'i dad pa mthu sad pa: las 'phro ldan no rigs kyi bu: dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub thob: dam mi ldan rnams 233)phyir dengs shig: de nas skyabs sdom 'bogs pa ni: na mo: rang rig mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la: ma bcos dad pas skyabs su mchi: ma gyur sems can ma lus pa: 'khor ba'i 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol: lan gsum dang sems bskyed pa ni: hoḥ ma rig 'khor 'khyams 'gro ba kun: rnam grol sa la 'god pa'i phyir: rim gnyis lam mchog la 'jug nas: smon 'jug byang chub sems bskyed do: lan gsum dang yan bdun ni: hoḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la: rgyal rnams mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs:

dge tshogs ma gyur 'gro la bsngo: gdod ma'i gzhi la sangs rgyas shog lan gsum dang sdom bzung ni: hoḥ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin rgyal dgongs: bdag cag skal ldan rigs mchog la: bslab gsum yang dag gnad bstan 'tshal: srog gi phyir yang bsrung mtshams ni: sdom gsum don dang 'gal mi bgyid: bslab pa ji bzhin bdag 234)gis bsrung: lan gsum dang: slob dpon gyis: e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu: 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: khyod kyi ngag tu blud pa yis: dam bsrung dngos grub 'dzin pa'i chu: mchog gi myur lam mngon du byed: dam 'das rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung: de phyir dam tshig ma nyams srungs: badz+ra sa ma ya na ra kan: dam chu blud: oṃ tsak+ṣu bhan+dha wa ra ma ṇa ye swā hāḥ mig dar sbyin: oṃ a khaṃ wi ra hūm̐: me tog sbyin: de nas slob ma lhar gsal ba ni: oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā=sogs: stong pa'i ngang las: sna tshogs pad+ma zla gdan la: bam̐ yig yongs su=sogs: sa ma ya dza dzaḥ a be sha ya pheṃ pheṃ: a be sha ya a a: ye shes dbab pa'i lha tshogs thams cad ji srid sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du slob ma'i sgo gsum la rab tu gnas par gyur cig: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: de nas mig dar bsal ba ni: hoḥ bdag nyid rdo rje rgyal po yis: rang byung gser gyi thur ma 'dis: khyod kyi ma rig ling tog bsal: ye shes spyan du dbye bar bya: badz+ra dzñā na tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭa: de nas rig me dor ba ni: hoḥ mchog gsum bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis: slob ma'i 235)rig pa'i me tog 'di: sngon gyi las 'phro gang yod pa: lhag pa'i lha der 'bab par shog: pad+ma puṣ+pe sid+dhi hūm̐: de nas bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: chos dbyings brdal khyab bum pa ru: lhun grub rang gsal bdud rtsis bkang: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'gyur med sku yi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de nas gtso mo'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma:

ye shes gar bsgyur ḍā ki sa ra dzaḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sku yi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya= de nas mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: mkha' 'gro'i sku gsung thugs yon tan: phrin las lnga las rab sprul pa: sgyu 'phrul ye shes ḍā ki lngas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: sku lnga mngon gyur dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya= de nas rigs bdag bla ma'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: rgyal kun 'dus zhal rigs bdag rje: pad+ma saṃ bhas dbang bskur ro: kun la dbang bsgyur dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya= de nas bhan+dha bdud rtsi thogs la: hūm̐: bde chen pad+ma bhan+dha'i nang: zag med ye shes bcud kyis gtams: skal ldan 236)bu la dbang bskur ro: bzlas pa sngags kyi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: wak+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de nas thugs srog thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ spros bral mi shigs thig le'i klong: dga' 'khyil ye shes rang gsal dbus: ting 'dzin sems ma bam̐ yig dmar: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: spros bral thugs kyi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rig tsaka thogs la: hūm̐: shes rab ye shes sgyu ma'i sku: bcu drug lang tsho pad+ma'i rigs: nye rgyu'i pho nya bde bskyed ma: skal ldan bu la gtad pa yis: rtsa gsum gnas dag 'khor lor lnga'i: sgrib dag dga' mchog khyad lhan dang: dga' bral ye shes mngon gyur nas: shes rab ye shes dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: ma hā bho dhi tsit+ta a haṃ: de nas man shel thogs la: hūm̐: gdod nas dri med chos kyi sku: skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba yi: rig gdangs 'od gsal lhun gyis grub: rang gsal kun zlum man shel 'di: rten 'brel mtshon byed brda yi dbang: skal ldan dbu la bskur ba yis: mtshon bya don gyi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: de nas gtor ma thogs la:

237)hūm̐ hrī: rang byung ye shes gtor snod du: lhun grub rang gsal ba liṃ ta: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: dngos grub rnam gnyis thob par shog: rtsa sngags: ma hā ba liṃ ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥswā hā: de nas bka' dbang mtha' brten gas: dam tshig khas blangs gtang rag phul: bkra shis me tog 'thor ba dang: dge bsngo sogs kyis mtha' brgyan byaḥ dbang 'di thob pa'i skal ldan kun: mkha' 'gros dngos su rjes bzung nas: don gnyis spyod par the tshom med: sa ma ya: e ma: bde chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i: ye shes sgyu ma'i gar bsgyur ba: kun gzigs ye shes mtsho rgyal ngas: sgrub thabs rim pa bsam mi khyab: 'di ni rdo rje zhi ba mtsho'i: thugs dam mthil du bdag gis gdams: ma 'ongs snyigs dus mar gsham la: nga sprul nga dang gnyis med pa: su kha badz+ra dman pa'i tshul: brtul zhugs 'dzin pa gtsang ma'i rigs: mi srin bdud khams mdo smad phyogs: ma nges bstan 'gro'i dpal du shar: de dus mkha' 'gro'i smin byed 'di: gter srung tshe ring mched lnga yis: gter skal gtod la phrin las sgrubs: chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i bu lnga dang: thabs grogs ya gsum las can bdun: chos bdag gtso bo nyer lnga dang: brgya dang rtsa brgyad la sogs pa: smon lam dbang gis 'phrad par nges: bzang 'brel mkha' 'gro'i gling du 'dren: ngan 'brel 'khor ba mtha' can 'gyur: the tshom med do sa ma ya: skal ldan bu dang 'phrad par 238)shog: log lta can la 'di ma 'phrad: dregs pa rnam gsum gnyer gyis shig: dam tshig can la rtag tu srungs: sa ma ya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: sbas rgya: gu h+ya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di yang dus ring mo nas brda don gsal yang gzhan dbang la ltos nas snyoms las su song skabs skal ldan chos kyi bdag po 'dul 'dzin mkhas pa'i dbang po rat+na pa shaṃ dang nye char dge btsun shī la badz+ra bcas kyis rin chen gnyis pa dang pañtsa ka shi'i mdangs 'dzin bcas yang yang bskul ngor chos nyid rig pa'i gab sgrom las bde chen chos nyid dbang mos dag par bris pa'o//

dge'o// ༈ bde chen mtsho rgyal ma'i dbang bshad kha bsgyur ni/ da lan gyi skabs su babs pa chos nyid dgongs pa'i klong mdzod/ lus med mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud zab chos kyi skor las bde chen mtsho rgyal ma'i gsang dbang skal ldan rjes 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa= sogs dbang gi lhan thabs ltar ro/
